note: Scenario assumptions for THESIS.md section 6b and the dashboard sliders. These are ASSUMPTIONS chosen on 12 Nov 2026 to span plausible paths; they are not forecasts and not price targets. Starting values (volume, take-rate, supply, price, market cap, NEAR in custody) come from data/derived/metrics.json. Edit this file and rebuild to change them.

scenarios.label: Bear: volume shrinks, capture falls, custody leaks
Base: volume grows 25%/yr, today's take-rate, HSP-029 activates
Bull: volume grows 60%/yr, take-rate rises to 8 bps, HSP-029 activates
Stress: activity booms but capture weakens and half of custody is released each year
